handoff.review_notes: Mechanical validation attempted with the kit's own validator logic via the repaired scratch copy (see ../curCS-validate-scratch/README-SCRATCH.txt): every record in this batch fails only on raw reference replay (e.g. decimal-gigabyte-to-byte@r2/one-gb-decimal: numerical reference does not match (1)), exactly as the canonical-units decision entails - the engine converts GB->bytes before evaluating, so staging replay passes while raw display-value replay cannot. Schema, grammar, guards, rejection cases, and integration cross-checks are otherwise clean; no other defect found. The shipped curCS-kit cannot run its own tools (ModuleNotFoundError: connected_models.constants). No integration, runtime_model, source, or evidence changes. Not packed: pack requires validation to pass under the current raw checker. Coordinator decision needed on unit-aware reference checks.
handoff.summary: Correction batch c02 (computer-science native): 12 canonical-identity r2s - brief-1 byte conversions x2 (decimal-gigabyte, binary-gibibyte) and brief-2A rate identities x10 (b04 x3, b05 x4, b07 kilobit/kibibit/gigabyte-rate).
